character: A large linked ski area around the Arlberg pass in western Austria, sold on one ticket and spanning St. Anton and St. Christoph in Tyrol and Stuben, Zürs, Lech, Oberlech, Zug, Warth and Schröcken in Vorarlberg. The Flexenbahn gondola links Zürs with Stuben and the St. Anton side, and the Auenfeldjet links Lech with Warth-Schröcken; the area is known for extensive off-piste routes.
learning: Reference note: each village has its own ski schools and nursery slopes. Confirm which village suits a beginner stay, and the ski-school and lesson products.
